calls.title: Walkthrough w/ Nhat
calls.summary: The team is working on improving chart and table visualizations for internal event tracking metrics. Key progress includes the near completion of event forwarder visualizations, which now track vital metrics with clear color-coded tooltips. UX challenges have been identified in custom date range comparisons, particularly regarding color schemes and length comparisons. Bar chart designs are also under review for better clarity between current and previous periods, with suggestions for offsets to enhance distinction. Additionally, a new big number display accommodates multiple metrics but requires alignment with product goals to avoid confusion. Efforts to resolve bugs and enhance user interaction and feedback are prioritized, with Figma mockups planned for prototyping improvements.
calls.keywords: event forwarder, custom date range, bar chart, big number metrics, UX feedback, data visualization

**Nhat Ho**

Fix UI bugs related to date range selection, tooltip display issues, and highlighting the correct selected date ranges in custom selectors (13:45)
Investigate and potentially implement UI improvements such as linking bar chart elements and customizing legends based on Johnny’s upcoming design input (14:50)

Create and share Figma mockups addressing the custom date range UI and bar chart overlay options to improve UX for comparing current and previous periods (12:30)
Review bar chart stacking and offset visualization to improve clarity and feedback on whether stacking all metrics into one bar makes sense (09:15)
Continue development work using screenshots captured from the walkthrough and follow up with Nhat for clarifications or further demos (16:04)

calls.title: Walkthrough w/ Nhat
calls.summary: The team discussed numerous data visualization enhancements, emphasizing improvements in chart and table clarity and user interactivity. Changes included refining tooltip and opacity settings for line charts to enhance readability, addressing usability issues in custom date range selectors, and implementing clearer indicators in table views to distinguish current and previous metrics. The introduction of big number cards now allows for multiple metrics in a single display. Bar chart visuals need clearer differentiation between current and previous metrics to aid interpretation. The meeting also highlighted UI bug fixes, plans for warnings when switching metric counts, and collaborative design efforts to finalize improvements before release.
calls.keywords: custom date range, big number metrics, bar chart visualization, line chart tooltip, UI/UX feedback, metric comparison
